_comment: Diagnosis metadata for the tests in designs/apb_gpio/tb/tb_apb_gpio.sv.
'spec_ref' names the heading in designs/apb_gpio/docs/apb_gpio_regs.md that states
the behaviour; 'pass_condition' restates the check in the spec's own words.
src/asic_agent/agents/diagnose.py uses both: if the spec never discusses what the test
checks, the failure is a spec_ambiguity, not an implementation_bug.
Ids must match the dispatcher entries in the testbench.
'observes' lists the DUT outputs the test checks, most specific first.

test_cases.description: Every register reads its default value 0x0 after reset
test_cases.pass_condition: PADDIR, GPIOEN, PADOUT, INTEN, INTTYPE, INTSTATUS and PADCFG all read reset value 0x0

test_cases.description: PADDIR is R/W and drives the pad direction
test_cases.pass_condition: PADDIR reads back the written value; bit[i]=1 is output mode for GPIO[i]

test_cases.description: PADOUT is R/W and drives the output data
test_cases.pass_condition: PADOUT reads back the written value and DATA_OUT[i] is the output data on GPIO[i]

test_cases.description: PADOUTSET sets and PADOUTCLR clears individual PADOUT bits
test_cases.pass_condition: PADOUTSET bit[i]=1 sets GPIO[i]; PADOUTCLR bit[i]=1 clears GPIO[i]; bit=0 no change

test_cases.description: INTTYPE and PADCFG are R/W with per-pad field packing
test_cases.pass_condition: INTTYPE and PADCFG read back the written value for each GPIO

test_cases.description: Pad input appears in PADIN within 4 cycles when GPIOEN is set
test_cases.pass_condition: With GPIOEN set, DATA_IN[i] input data of GPIO[i] appears in PADIN within 4 cycles

test_cases.description: Input clock gating is per group of 4 GPIOs
test_cases.pass_condition: GPIOs are gathered by groups of 4; the clock gating of one group is done only if all 4 GPIOs are disabled in GPIOEN

test_cases.description: INTTYPE 01 raises INTSTATUS on a rising edge
test_cases.pass_condition: INTTYPE 01 interrupt on rising edge for GPIO[i] with INTEN enable sets INTSTATUS[i]

test_cases.description: INTTYPE 00 raises INTSTATUS on a falling edge
test_cases.pass_condition: INTTYPE 00 interrupt on falling edge for GPIO[i] with INTEN enable sets INTSTATUS[i]

test_cases.description: INTTYPE 10 raises INTSTATUS on both edges
test_cases.pass_condition: INTTYPE 10 interrupt on rising and falling edge for GPIO[i] with INTEN enable sets INTSTATUS[i]
INTEN bit[i]=0 disable interrupt for GPIO[i]: INTSTATUS[i] is not set and the interrupt line is not set

test_cases.description: INTSTATUS is cleared when it is read
test_cases.pass_condition: INTSTATUS[i]=1 after interrupt received on GPIO[i]; INTSTATUS is cleared when it is red

test_cases.description: Interrupt line stays high until INTSTATUS is read
test_cases.pass_condition: GPIO interrupt line is held asserted as a level from the edge until INTSTATUS register is red, then cleared

test_cases.description: Unmapped offsets and the 32-63 bank read 0 with PAD_NUM=32
test_cases.pass_condition: Reads of unmapped offsets return 0 without error, and PADDIR_32_63 reads 0 when only 32 pads exist

test_cases.description: INTTYPE 11 (RFU) behaves as a level-high interrupt
test_cases.pass_condition: With INTTYPE 11 and INTEN set, INTSTATUS[i] is raised while GPIO[i] is held high, as a level-sensitive interrupt
